justification: The prose is straightforward and functional, effectively conveying the scene and character actions.

Some sentences are overly long or convoluted, which interrupts smooth reading (e.g., the paragraph about the ladder and toolshed).
The narrative occasionally lapses into telling rather than showing, which weakens engagement.
evidence: 'A man dead in his bead.'
'The private detective whoever he was, hadn’t arrived yet.'
'A pill overdose. Or maybe the death and break-in were two different things totally Jamie thought.'
'He bent to one knee and tried to observe everything on the ground as he had seen detectives do in movies.'
